title: Bound a jointly decoded batch without inventing independent calibration errors
statement: One common compression on N training and M possibly entangled payload outputs gives conditional channel C_(U,t)^tensorM. If e0=k sqrt(3delta), total batch half-diamond error<=M e0+beta+gamma, where bad training contributes ONCE and gamma covers the entire batch. Independent pre-encoding Weyl keys give conditional product Pauli noise only after their retirement. Shared bad calibration is not independent averaged noise.

requires: Same stationary memoryless source; one joint batch with protected outputs/references
Fresh recovery ancillas and actual independent logical Weyl keys before source encoding when using the noise corollary

assumptions: All training outputs/references and payload remain coherent through ONE batch. The learned small decoder belongs to that batch and is not reusable on later original-D outputs. The factor2 all-accepted inverse floor, max(0,1-delta)^2 fidelity range, exact rational feasibility/fallback and total reference-safe implementation error are mandatory. Query count is polynomial in intrinsic dimensions/inverse accuracy, with enormous explicit constants; ambient storage and controls are paid. Fixed-d predecessor compiler and separately reviewed uniform compiler have distinct costs. No source-memory/drift, hardware, optimal-query or novelty claim.
costs: At least(N+M)log D output storage, references, all training calls, full batch controls/latency; accuracy target forces e0 to shrink withM
contract.units: Joint half-diamond error on arbitrary payload/reference, one shared statistical failure event; no indefinite reusable training bank or outer-code rate theorem.
